chapter_note: This chapter is overwhelmingly cosmological substrate. After a single dialogue-frame opener (i=3), the chapter expounds the Five Greatnesses systematically (Father of Greatness; Mother of Life/Great Spirit; Great Builder/Living Spirit; Third Ambassador/Pillar of Glory; Jesus the Radiance), then deploys an elaborate sequence of cosmological similes (the noble man surrounded by enemies = First Man; the judge sent by the king = Living Spirit; the great king inspecting craftsmen = Third Ambassador; the hot stone in milk = Call/Answer/Enthumesis). All similes map cosmos→cosmos: the human figures are explicit similes for cosmic agents, not pointers to contemporary institutions. Editorial fatigue score is strongly NEGATIVE (-0.67) — substrate vocabulary INCREASES in the second half, the opposite of editorial drift, confirming the page is genuinely substratic. Damage ratio 84% is high but the surviving frame is coherent. The only editorial seam is i=3.
